verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an HR/payroll platform with an API, CLI and agent, but the evidence never documents batch or bulk endpoints, or multi-item actions. The documented endpoints act on single records (e.g., creating a benefit deduction for one worker), and pagination only covers listing results, not acting on many items at once. Scheduled jobs and the agent are adjacent automation features, not documented bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
